quote: This game honestly deserves WAY more than a 10. its so relaxing and fun to unwind with my friends. the puzzles really put you to the test and it also builds teamwork with your friends. getting lost in this game is honestly so fun! you could work your way alone to find your friends for over like 10 minutes in silence. i totally advice everyone to get this game
